book.name: LEVELAISIYONI
book.title: Jonida alikamu lo moloko lo mibo ga

content: Omaimidana sipisipi jalalimo pepaya wasawaki liye.

Sa-okaiyoko onowelaki siyalo minokaka noibo welimoya ade lamawakaloka pepa wasawaki leneyoko mudaoe. Ito aya pepamidana omudaloka emesaloka maya luhuwa ji-minayoko mudaoboya, huma 7-loti moli omiki lolo i-minabo ne.
Okanaki we abuha-wowolaki neyoko mudaobo welimoya ga napauti sa-loko liye: Nakaha welimoya wehe lo-minoe loko maya pepamidana humala kawa sideko woko wehe letiye.
Loko liboya, wewena mako okulumauti ito maya mikaukati ito mika ulautiya aya pepamidana humala maya kawa sitabo nesa lamiye.
Sakoya aya pepa maya kawa setiboto we mako koheko nebo we minamiyoko nemo muluneu lahelamiyoko wije nama loe.

Sakoya wije nama noloyoko, we loidawa makolimoya wije amoko mudao. Juda wewenasida nalautiya okohimi ula laiyonikidana nebo we soto pibo maya Dewitida awola nebo welimo Olohamidana asetokadanaki pepa huma 7-loti moli omiminabo maya kawa sekolaiye loko liye.

Loko noliyoko, nemoya nomuda hulo moloko onowelaki siyalo elewole nesa loweki lowekiki ito olopa we loidawa luwawanipou maya sipisipi ja akalewa makomamidana kohai moli-minayoko, alo helenebomidana mudaobo ne. Sipiyala 7-pala nebo ito omudala asako 7-pala neboya Omaimidana weuna oluhola abuha-wowola 7-pala nebo wemidanaya Omaimo oli hekaiyoko ma mikauka suwonebo weuna oluhomidana aweyahala ne.
Ito akalewalimoya woko onowelaki siyalo nebo wemamidana ade lamawakati maya woko wasawaki pepa maya liye.

Sakoya lekaiyoko elewole oko minokaka nesa loweki lowekima ito olopa we loidawa 24-palamasiya ja akalewamidana amaekuka maya lipi miki minae. Sa-ikadanaki, nama letiye liki nama likaka nesa napa maya li-minadanaki, lape makoya golidunu lolo abo lapekiya dadeuya makoko makoko iki li-minae. Nuwalaki paula Omaitoka jokila hi mikaka paula nuwala dowa loko wibo paulamidana maya aya lapeuma waitoneyoko monoka likaka niabo wewenasiya Omailoka likaka niabo nesamidana aweyahawa ne.
Sakiya nama ohatama makoya sa-liki lae:

content.text: Pepamidana humala kawa setadawoto maya koheko minane. Emoda kohaelikayoko heledanaki oladakadunuya muki numuto namato wewenasida aito aito donoki ito aito aito dupaki ito aito aito nalauti minabo wewenasida maya muki meina heko magoinaya dilipe Omailoka moladawo maya ne.
Ahote Omaida elekele itatae loko oholau maya emolatoka jokila hi mitabo we loko dilipe moladawo maya ne. Sadawo wewenasiya maya mikauka ujapa iki miniki ulinipokiya minakilae.

content: Sa-okaiyoko, aku nomuda hulo moloko mudaoboya muki okananipoki wewenasida depauti maya muki ga maya eloe. Aya okananipoki wewenasida nabanipo maya 100 miliyoni tauseni tauseniya minae. Edimoya onowelaki siyalo ito elewole nesa loweki loweki ito we loidawa minabotoka hi wego iki ga napa liki nama sa-liki lae:

content.text: Akalewa maya omutiki kohai helebo welimoya abuha-wowo ito uvamina ito ele wewesokaka nesa ito elewoleya litibo ito muki wewenasi epoka liki emo uliwa li sawa jideko emo uliwaya yoweko netiboya koheko netibo ne liki lae.

content: Nemoya muki okulumauka nebo nesa ito maya mikauka nebo nesa ito mika ulauka nebo nesa ito ela no ulauka minabo nesasikiya sa-liki nama nilayoko eloe:

content.text: Onowelaki siyalo nebo wemamidana ito akalewamamidana epoka loko uliwa maya le sawa jekuniyoko, lameda lokaka ito elewoleya emotoka maya mino-loko woko mino luwatoka moloko minakolaiye.

content: Liki likayoko elewole iki minikaka nesa loweki lowekimasi donoto liki yotokoe liki likayoko olopa we loidawamasiya di bola hi miki monoka liki uliwa li sawa je. 1 Aes 29:11; Iji 2:9-10 5 Jen 49:9; Aes 11:1,10 6 Aes 53:7; Jek 4:10 8 Sam 141:2 9 Sam 33:3; Sam 98:1 10 Eks 19:6; Lev 1:6 11 Den 7:10
